description_EA_Rage: Inflict bleeding, poisoning and burning simultaneously ten times.
description_EA_Rage_hints:
1) The blacksmith in Oxenfurt sells Broadhead Bolts, which apply bleeding with 100% certainty. Tracking Bolts do not apply the kind of bleeding this achievement needs, even though their description says +100% bleeding chance.
2) Burning can be applied by Igni with a high probability, but also by the Dancing Star bomb.
3) Poison is easiest to apply with the Devil's Puffball: while the enemy stands in its area it keeps the poison on. Alternatively, the Viper steel sword found in White Orchard has a 15% chance to poison.
